description: Reference choreography from the @phatboylandy TikTok (15.5 s clip; dancer on screen 0.2-11.5 s, then a ~4 s TikTok end card). Solo full-body dancer outdoors who walks in from the left (tracker id 3). Move boundaries from the wrist/elbow/ankle trajectories and motion energy of data/dance/pose/phatboylandy_d2b6e7.npz (see docs/DANCE_MODEL_INTERFACE.md section 4 for the schema).
bpm_estimate_note: Estimated from the alternating knee lifts, which peak at 3.10, 3.87, 4.63, 5.33, 6.10, 6.80, 7.50 and 8.23 s (mean period 0.733 s = 81.8 bpm, one lift per beat). Arm positions change every ~1.47 s (two lifts). If each lift is a half-note the track is 164 bpm; unverified until the track is identified.

moves.name: Ready: walks in from the left, turns to face the camera and stands still with arms down
Hands pressed together at the chest while alternating knee lifts
Both arms thrown straight up overhead in a V, knee lifts continue
Arms fold across the chest with hands on opposite shoulders, knee lifts continue
Fists pump up beside the face and drop to the waist twice, one knee lift per pump
Arms drop, feet step out wide and the hips sink into a squat with hands on the hips
Wide bent-knee stance with hands on hips, held with a slight bounce

notes: Dancer is absent (ok=False) for frames 0-5 (0.00-0.17 s) and from frame 345 (11.50 s) to the end: the clip closes with a ~4 s TikTok end card. Last ok frame is 344 (11.47 s), so the final move ends at 11.45 s.

'ready' is the count-in and starts at the first ok frame (6, 0.20 s): it covers the walk-in from the left edge (0.2-1.5 s, side-on, hip x goes from 0 to 0.55 of the frame width) and the still stand facing the camera (1.5-2.75 s). The judge's reference clock starts count_in_s after the first ok learner frame unless set_ref_clock is used.

All 17 joints are visible in >=96% of ok frames (ankles 99-100%), so the 'legs' fault can fire on this dance. The knee lifts alternate between the npz 'left' and 'right' leg every 0.733 s, two lifts per arm position; the lifted foot comes up to roughly knee height.

Upper-body changes used as boundaries: wrists rise to the chest 2.80-2.90 s, overhead (height > 1.4 torso) 4.47-5.83 s, arms crossed (L wrist x < R wrist x) 5.87-7.27 s, fist-pump peaks 7.5 and 8.2 s, wrists below 0.4 torso from 8.57 s, hip drop into the squat at 8.97 s, stance settles by ~9.2 s.
